mappings.note: Content matches: 'For behold your enemies make a noise...' (v3).
Content matches: 'They devise crafty plans against thy people...' (v4).
Content matches: 'Come let us cut them off from being a nation...' (v5).
Content matches: 'For they have consulted together with one consent...' (v6).
Content matches: List of enemies starting with Edom and Ishmaelites (v7).
Content matches: Continuation of list including Gebal, Ammon, etc. (v8).
Content matches: 'Assur also is joined with them...' including Selah (v9).
Content matches: Comparison to Midian, Sisera, Jabin at Kishon (v10).
Content matches: 'They were destroyed in En-dor...' (v11).
Content matches: Comparison of princes to Oreb and Zeeb, etc. (v12). Note: WLC v12 includes 'Zebah' which corresponds to OSMAIN's 'Sebah', same name.
Content matches: 'They said Let us take for ourselves the strongholds of God' (v13).
Content matches: 'Make them like a whirling wind...' (v14). Note: WLC uses 'galgal' (wheel/whirlwind) which OSMAIN translates as 'virvlende tistelull' (tumbleweed), same imagery.
Content matches: Fire burning forest and hills in flames (v15).
Content matches: Pursue with storm and tempest (v16).
Content matches: Fill faces with shame so they seek Thy name (v17).
WLC v18 contains the first part of OSMAIN v18 ('Let them be ashamed...'), but WLC continues into a new verse (v19) which is missing in OSMAIN.

This verse exists only in the WLC translation. It contains: 'And let them know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.' This text is not present in OSMAIN v18 or any other provided verse.

extraContent.description: WLC v19 contains a concluding doxology ('And let them know that thou...') which is absent in the OSMAIN text (which ends at verse 18).
